description: Romance hardens into betrayal as Alison faces the aftermath of Keith, Michael's affairs pull Jane, Sydney and Kimberly into open warfare, Jo becomes entangled with Reed's criminal life, and Amanda increasingly treats both D and D and the apartment complex as territory to control.

s02e01.description: Amanda engineers a housewarming party around her pursuit of Billy, keeping Alison trapped at work so the field is conveniently clear.

s02e02.description: Billy remains suspicious of Keith's hold over Alison, while Alison agrees to drive Keith to the airport and revisit unfinished emotions.

s02e03.description: Billy confronts Keith violently; Alison rejects Keith, and his final desperate act leaves her carrying a devastating emotional burden.

s02e04.description: Alison's drinking begins threatening her job, forcing Billy to push her toward confronting the guilt she feels over Keith's death.

s02e05.description: Jake learns he caused the shop fire and lashes out destructively, leading Jo to throw him out when his anger becomes unbearable.

s02e06.description: Friends fail to reconcile Jake and Jo, while Amanda forces the estranged pair into a tense photo assignment together.

s02e07.description: Jane finally throws Sydney out, only for Amanda to give Sydney an apartment at Melrose and keep the family conflict conveniently nearby.

s02e08.description: Amanda's father offers Jake lucrative restoration work; Jake initially refuses, then changes course after becoming involved with Amanda.

s02e09.description: Sydney takes a job at Shooters and becomes entangled with Michael, until Kimberly catches them and exposes the affair to Jane.

s02e10.description: A weekend at Steve's ranch stirs Billy's jealousy over Alison, while Jo realizes she remains emotionally attached to Jake.

s02e11.description: Michael reconnects with Kimberly and proposes; after heavy drinking, a celebratory drive ends in a catastrophic crash.

s02e12.description: Amanda sends Alison to San Francisco on business, forcing her to miss Thanksgiving and deepening the tension between work and personal life.

s02e13.description: Michael is told Kimberly died and begins rehabilitation, persuading Jane to take him in despite Robert's objections.

s02e14.description: Steve prepares to leave for Europe and declares his feelings, but Alison abruptly chooses the possibility of reconciling with Billy.

s02e15.description: Billy slips away from Amanda but still rejects Alison's attempt at reconciliation, while Matt tries to give Nikki a proper Christmas.

s02e16.description: Billy tells Amanda that he and Alison have reunited, and Amanda retaliates by stripping Alison of a major account.

s02e17.description: Alison formally challenges Amanda's treatment at work, while FBI questions about Amanda's father force her into an unwanted leave.

s02e18.description: Sydney reveals Michael's manipulation and her prostitution involvement to Jane, who finally turns her anger toward Michael.

s02e19.description: Amanda and Jo invest in Reed's boating venture as Jake joins the operation, while Michael quietly develops a painkiller addiction.

s02e20.description: Jake discovers holes in Reed's story and pulls out, but Jo dismisses his warning just as Reed's drug operation becomes impossible to ignore.

s02e21.description: Reed's final drug run traps Jo aboard his boat, forcing her into a lethal confrontation when he turns a gun on her.

s02e22.description: Jo faces murder charges after Reed's death, while Jake is furious that Amanda refuses to risk herself by helping.

s02e23.description: Sydney and Jane's battle over a family wedding dress erupts spectacularly as their mother arrives and Sydney's marriage plans continue.

s02e24.description: Michael takes Sydney on a honeymoon to northern California, where his attempts to eliminate his inconvenient new wife repeatedly fail.

s02e25.description: Billy follows Alison to her father's birthday in Wisconsin and is angered when she refuses to announce their engagement.

s02e26.description: Alison seeks psychiatric help for recurring nightmares, while Amanda solves Jane's money troubles by making Michael her business partner.

s02e27.description: Jake and Billy repair their friendship, while Jo and Amanda discover that an obsessive intruder has been hiding above Amanda's apartment.

s02e28.description: Michael is stunned when Kimberly returns alive after months in a coma, immediately destabilizing every arrangement built around her supposed death.

s02e29.description: Kimberly warns Sydney away from Michael, while Lauren reappears and demands a large payment that Sydney cannot easily produce.

s02e30.description: Amanda resents Jake's concern for injured Jo, while Billy urges Alison to stay silent about damaging information involving Amanda and Chas.

s02e31-32.description: Amanda faces a massive harassment suit without support from her agency, while Jo fears Amanda still intends to reclaim Jake. Jake sleeps with Amanda and Jo catches the aftermath, ending their relationship despite Jake's insistence that the betrayal meant nothing.
